title: Crossed objective and feasibility discrepancy benchmark

candidate_pool.source: Seed-offset Halton pool from the existing scenario contract
candidate_pool.pairing: Exact same coordinates for every policy within a seed/scenario-composition/dimension/severity cell
candidate_pool.truth: Existing analytic truth, identical across fidelity-discrepancy families

composition_contract.objective_component: Objectives returned by objective_family at each fidelity
composition_contract.constraint_component: Constraint margin returned by constraint_family at each fidelity
composition_contract.high_fidelity: Both components resolve to the same analytic truth function
composition_contract.diagonal_cells: Expected to reproduce each existing single-family mismatch mechanism
composition_contract.off_diagonal_cells: Create crossed objective/constraint mismatch combinations; report separately from diagonal controls
composition_contract.intended_question: Do policies tuned or inspected only on isolated mismatch families preserve decision quality when objective ranking errors and feasibility errors arise from different mechanisms?
composition_contract.caveat: This is a compositional synthetic stress test, not evidence that its compositions match empirical foundry distributions.

budget.charge_rule: Every fidelity oracle call is charged its configured cost; no extra truth query is given to the policy. Audit truth is queried after policy termination.

policies.role: decision-impact-weighted acquisition using predicted feasible hypervolume gain, boundary information and frontier objective uncertainty
policies.method_class: interpretable heuristic; not exact posterior expected value of information

outputs: Paired-seed contrasts versus high_only on each cell
Independent response replay and source-byte digests
Decision-impact acquisition score and uncertainty components for the new candidate policy

acceptance_gates.execution: Authored tests must pass locally before any empirical statement; runner artifacts must be retained.
acceptance_gates.replay: Independent scorer must reject any changed evaluation value, cost count, candidate-pool hash, promotion margin, or result identity.
acceptance_gates.composition: Diagonal cells must numerically match the corresponding existing scenario runner under matched inputs; test this as a property gate.
acceptance_gates.statistics: Three-seed defaults are diagnostic only. Minimum 20 paired seeds; target 30 for inferential comparisons; preregister multiple-comparison correction and report per-cell effects.
acceptance_gates.external: No SOTA claim until pinned BoTorch MF-HVKG/MOMF and suitable single-fidelity baselines are executed under matched budgets; retain COCO-native scoring on COCO tasks.
acceptance_gates.physical: No casting-validity claim without validated multiphysics models, documented solver uncertainty, and held-out physical measurements.
acceptance_gates.decision_value_policy: The sixth policy uses the frozen 60/8/4 fidelity-call template and preregistered score weights; all acquisition inputs must be derived only from observations available before each high-fidelity call.

provenance.limitation: SHA-256 digests establish byte identity, not signer identity or proof of execution. This receipt is unsigned and synthetic.

decision_value_policy.label: Decision-Impact-Weighted Acquisition (DIWA)
decision_value_policy.scope: transparent heuristic baseline, not an exact Bayesian value-of-information estimator

score_definition.expected_hypervolume_gain: predicted probability of feasibility multiplied by positive marginal 2D hypervolume gain normalized by the fixed reference rectangle

limitations: Uncertainty is estimated from small paired low/medium/high residual samples, not a calibrated posterior.
Weights are heuristic and must be frozen before the measured comparison; run a separate preregistered weight-sensitivity track.
Two high-fidelity anchors limit calibration quality; this is a hypothesis to benchmark, not an established improvement.
